Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vikram - 37 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Vimla - 64 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Pallavi and Vikram stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Dad, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Pallavi: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Nikhil munches on an apple.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

[Nikhil serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Nikhil: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Nikhil: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil claps his hands.]

Pallavi (surprised): "One more time!"

[Nikhil points at the sky.]

Nikhil (softly): "What next?"

[Nikhil nods.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look at this."

[Nikhil shouts angrily.]

Nikhil: "Yes, all right."

[Nikhil gives Mother a flower.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil takes the bag from Mother.]

Nikhil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
